text:
Support: @emma incoming customer escalation: prod app sees 401s + massive latency after region failover. Customer: AcmePayments. They say requests hit eu-west fallback and responses are truncated/malformed. sample request/response below.
Emma: got it, can you paste request id + model? which region did they pin?
Support: request id 01F8Y7Z9C3 model: redwood/gptx-2b v202407; customer pinned us-west but failover routed to eu-west-quant. Below is raw error from their app:
Support: ```
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"tokenizer_mismatch","details":"unexpected token id 502 (vocab mismatch)","served_model":"redwood/gptx-2b-lite-q"}
```
Raj: hmm tokenizer_mismatch suggests served model variant uses different vocab. Our config should fallback only to compatible variants. Checking routing logs...
OpsOncallBot: alert: region-failover eu-west triggered for pool us-west-40 at 2026-03-10T14:22Z. Fallback policy: allow_compatible_variants=false
Emma: they have auto-routing with prefer_region=true. Looks like policy was mis-evaluated and quantized-lite variant, which has separate tokenizer, was chosen.
Luis: I'm pulling the router policy and kernel mapping. I see an edge case: for reserved pools with 'allow_compat=false' we still consider 'capacity_compat' flag. Fix candidate: ensure tokenizer identity check before fallback decision.
Maya: customer is seeing billing spike too because retries from client + fallback. They want a rollback or explicit model pin to us-west.
Emma: short repro for infra: 1) set X-Region: us-west header and pin model id to redwood/gptx-2b v202407 2) simulate node outage in us-west 3) requests should either 503 or route to redwood/gptx-2b v202407-quant (compatible). Current behavior routes to redwood/gptx-2b-lite-q (incompatible)
Raj: temp mitigation: add routing rule to prioritize exact tokenizer match for customer AcmePayments id=acct_03A. I've applied a policy: router.override.acct_03A = prefer_exact_tokenizer
Support: customer confirmed reduced errors after rule applied, but still wants root cause and a permanent fix + retroactive billing credit. Customer rep: @Maya will follow up.
Emma: I'll open PR to add tokenizer-compatibility check in router decision path and include unit tests + integration sim.
Luis: scheduling hotfix deploy to canary tonight. Tagging @raj for review.
Support: thanks team, keeping thread open until postmortem. :thumbsup:
